sentences.text: A study describes the healthy vaginal microbiota as typically dominated by Lactobacillus species, with dominance of other taxa often signalling dysbiosis.
That study examined Lactobacillus gasseri among strains isolated from the vaginal environment of fertile and menopausal women, using genomic screening and comparative genomics.

It reports that vaginal Lactobacillus strains are genomically adapted to this niche, and that Lactobacillus gasseri showed genetic traits equivalent and complementary to the most vaginally specialized species, Lactobacillus crispatus.
A study of 216 postmenopausal women given local estradiol vaginal tablets reported that after twelve weeks the abundance of Lactobacillus gasseri, L. crispatus and L. jensenii increased.
